description: Returns the exact input, result, success, and failure schemas for one registered Action. The target may be supplied under any parameter name; action is preferred.

action.description: Canonical Action method or MCP tool name, such as "Input.click" or "input_click".

requiresPurpose.description: Whether this Action requires a non-empty purpose field.

actionRevision.description: Content revision of this Action definition.

inputSchema.description: Complete declared input schema, including union branches and field descriptions.

resultSchema.description: Business result schema returned by the Action implementation.

outputSchema.description: Public success envelope schema for this Action.

failureSchema.description: Stable public failure envelope and field meanings.

purposeHint.description: Action-specific wording for the purpose field, when required.

observation.description: Factual observation of the completed Action and its current visible result.

suggested_prompt.description: Action-specific next-step guidance based on the returned result.
